{"id":1589924876,"question_id":3636,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 3 months","timestamp":1743243675,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1589924876/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Check Balanced String","memory":"8.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool isBalanced(string num) {\n        int even = 0;\n        int odd = 0;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<num.size() ; i++)\n        {\n           if(i&1)\n           odd += num[i]-'0';\n           else\n           even += num[i]-'0';\n        }\n        return (even == odd);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"check-balanced-string","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":510}
